policy.axis: Original seaward v vectors are linearly interpolated at the geodesic fraction, converted from spherical-ground Web Mercator to local WGS84 ENU [N/a*vx,M/a*vy] at the station latitude, and normalized.
policy.exact_control_station: left_profile_id equals right_profile_id; fraction is zero.
policy.boundaries: Municipalities separate; absent or unreviewable 2011 controls, port-line intersections and residual gaps are never connected.
policy.structures: Only unreviewable 2011 structural reference locations and port crossings; not every structure mapped in 2026.

limitations: 100 m refers to ellipsoidal chainage along the 2011 reference geometry, not the straight chord across a bend.
Millimetre tolerance validates numerical stationing, not physical or photographic coastline accuracy.
Reviewed segments in Chelem and Chicxulub include digitized vertices from the 2011 photo. Other edges are interpolated between approved controls.
Municipal/scientific source coordinates, readings, guide corrections and acceptance flags are not modified.
